title: Refunds and Fees Specialists: Reopened Files and Long Statement Periods — Personal Sender Account
content:
**Preparation step for a callback on refunds and fees.** The preparation step reads the Personal Sender Account's earlier callbacks on refunds and fees and the period of its most recent statement request:

1. When 1 or more callbacks on refunds and fees were requested on the account in the 12 months before the callback request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting, the specialist reopens that file, and the fees callback window is half the counted fees callback window, rounded up to a whole business day.
2. When no such callback was requested in those 12 months and the most recent statement request covers more than 12 whole calendar months from its first day to its last day, the specialist prepares the longer period, and the fees callback window is the counted fees callback window plus half of it, that half rounded up to a whole business day.
3. Otherwise the fees callback window is the counted fees callback window.

The counted fees callback window is the callback's window in Paloma business days as counted before this step; the step acts on that whole figure once.

## Points of judgement

- Only earlier callbacks on the topic refunds and fees count in point 1; a callback on limits and levels does not.
- The period in point 2 is that of the statement request requested most recently on the account, measured in whole calendar months from its first day to its last day. A period of exactly 12 whole months is not more than 12.

## Decision table

| Callback on refunds and fees in the 12 months | Most recent statement period | Fees callback window |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | any | half the counted window, rounded up |
| none | more than 12 whole months | the counted window plus half of it, half rounded up |
| none | 12 whole months or fewer | the counted window |

## Worked figures (hypothetical counted windows)

| Counted fees callback window | File reopened | Longer period prepared |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 2 | 3 plus 2, that is 5 |
| 4 | 2 | 4 plus 2, that is 6 |
| 5 | 3 | 5 plus 3, that is 8 |
